watches.description: Gavox Equation From our Farther at sea collection Gavox 36mm Silver Dial, Elegance with Depth The new Gavox 36mm is an elegant unisex watch created to bring presence, refinement, and quiet originality to the wrist. Its design carries a subtle classical inspiration, with a touch of Cartier-like elegance, but reshaped with the Gavox spirit: personal, modern, and full of character. The 36mm stainless steel case makes the watch easy to wear for both men and women. It is compact, balanced, and comfortable, yet it has enough visual presence to feel special on the wrist. What makes this watch truly alive is its silvery structured dial . The dial has depth, texture, and a beautiful play of light. Depending on the angle, the surface changes, catches reflections, and reveals new details. It is not a flat dial. It feels architectural, almost like a small silver landscape under glass. Above the dial sits a Hardlex box crystal , giving the watch a warm vintage-inspired glow. This crystal creates reflections and distortions that make the dial feel deeper and more precious. It adds shine, charm, and that little optical magic that makes you want to look at the watch again and again. This is a two-hander watch , with only hours and minutes. No second hand, no unnecessary noise. The idea is simple: enjoy the beauty of time, not chase it. The purity of the two hands allows the dial, the crystal, and the case design to become the real stars. Inside the watch is a reliable Swiss Ronda 515 quartz movement , the same movement family used in the Gavox Stardust. It gives precision, ease of use, and peace of mind for daily wear. The watch is also made for real life. With 100 meters of water resistance , it is elegant enough for dinner, but strong enough for daily use, travel, rain, and summer life. watches.description: Inspired by the legendary Blackbird The Blackbird GMT – A personal memory Tribute This GAVOX Squadron GMT is inspired by the legendary SR-71 Blackbird and its predecessor, the A-12—mythical aircraft that defined an era of speed and secrecy. For Michael Happé, founder of GAVOX, the connection is deeply personal. While studying in Yuba City, California, he lived just a few kilometers from Beale Air Force Base. Lunchtimes were often spent at the base fence, watching the Blackbird and the U-2 take flight. That period was one of historic shifts: the fall of the USSR and the Berlin Wall, the debates in Belgium where the king briefly stepped aside over the abortion law. These moments marked a world in transition, and they are inseparable from the memories that fuel GAVOX’s passion for aviation and history. This special edition—limited to just 24 pieces—embodies both that era and the timeless fascination for flight. It is a watch made for those who share the passion for aviation, exploration, and the stories that shape our world. Reviews available: Gavox Longitude GMT Review Expl oring the open seas has long been an adventure that only the brav est dared to take . This was due to the difficulty of accurately determining the ship ‘s position . However , over the centuries , technology has been developed to make this task easier . G av ox Long itude pays tribute to the pioneering explorers of the past with its GMT function . In this article , we will delve into the history of these explorers and the development of the GMT function . S ailing on the open sea was a real adventure; only brave sailors dared to venture away from the coast . The reason was the impossibility of determining the ship ‘s position with respect to two reference axis . The latitude , the distance from the equ ator , could be estimated by observing the sun’s height at its highest point . But at that time , there was no reliable method to estimate the long itude , the distance from a north – south line passing through the port of departure, for example . The Dutch navig ator Dirk Hart og was one of these explorers . On one of his trips in 16 16 , he landed on an island that today bears his name . He was one of the very first Europeans to discover Australia . If the name Dirk Hart og doesn ‘t mean anything to you , that ‘s not the case for Michael Happ é , founder of G av ox , since he is a descendant of this explorer ! More than a century later , the development of the first precise marine clock allowed sailors to calculate long itude accurately . And it would take another century and a half for the Greenwich mer idian to become the world reference for defining time zones under the name of Greenwich Mean Time ( GMT ). The G av ox Long itude and its GMT function are a tribute to these adventurous explorers . If its dial po etically recalls a wind y sea , the GMT function offers a relatively rare technical feature . The new Miy ota 90 75 movement is a “ true ” GMT , with features similar to the Role x GMT . The GMT Miy ota 90 75 allows independent adjustment of the hour hand .
